# GoFundMe

> GoFundMe is the world's #1 crowdfunding and fundraising platform, trusted by 100M+ people to raise over $30B for personal, nonprofit, and community causes.

GoFundMe enables individuals, nonprofits, and organizations to create and manage fundraising campaigns across medical, memorial, emergency, and charitable causes. The platform provides comprehensive guides, safety guarantees, and tools for both fundraisers and donors to support meaningful causes globally.

## Key Topics

- Crowdfunding Platform
- Nonprofit Fundraising
- Fundraiser Setup
- Charitable Giving
- Fraud Prevention
- Donor Management
- GoFundMe.org
- Crisis Response
- Fundraising Tips
- Community Support
- Pricing & Fees
- GoFundMe Giving Guarantee
- Team Fundraising
- Fundraising Ideas
- Social Impact

## Getting Started

- [Start a Fundraiser on GoFundMe](https://www.gofundme.com/c/start): Create crowdfunding campaign with $30B+ raised on trusted platform
- [How GoFundMe Works](https://www.gofundme.com/c/how-it-works): Step-by-step guide: create fundraiser, share, manage donors, transfer funds
- [GoFundMe Homepage](https://www.gofundme.com): GoFundMe homepage: global crowdfunding platform trusted by 100M+ people

## Fundraising Guides & Tips

- [How To Have A Successful Fundraiser: 9 Tips to Spread the Word](https://www.gofundme.com/c/fundraising-tips): Tips for successful fundraising: campaign promotion and donor outreach
- [The Best Fundraising Ideas to Reach Your Goal](https://www.gofundme.com/c/fundraising-ideas): Creative fundraising ideas and strategies for nonprofits and individuals
- [Fundraising for Teams: Tips for a Successful Fundraiser](https://www.gofundme.com/c/fundraising-tips/team): Guide to collaborative team fundraising optimization and donor management
- [GoFundMe Fundraising Blog](https://www.gofundme.com/c/blog): Blog with fundraising trends, ideas, and crowdfunding resources

## Nonprofit & Charity Fundraising

- [GoFundMe for Nonprofits](https://www.gofundme.com/c/charity-fundraising): Nonprofit fundraising platform with free pages and supporter-led tools
- [Start A Charity Fundraiser](https://www.gofundme.com/start/charity-fundraising): Guide to creating fundraisers for nonprofits, charities, and NGOs
- [Social Impact with GoFundMe.org](https://www.gofundme.com/c/cause): GoFundMe.org social impact funds for disaster relief and community support

## Safety, Trust & Pricing

- [GoFundMe Giving Guarantee](https://www.gofundme.com/c/safety/gofundme-guarantee): Donor protection guarantee with money-back policy and fraud prevention
- [Pricing and Fees](https://www.gofundme.com/c/pricing): GoFundMe pricing, transaction fees, and multi-country fee structure
- [About GoFundMe](https://www.gofundme.com/c/about-us): Company overview: mission, platform features, and giving statistics

## Community & Discovery

- [GoFundMe Discover](https://www.gofundme.com/discover): Browse fundraisers across medical, memorial, emergency, nonprofit categories
- [Supporter Space](https://www.gofundme.com/c/supporter-space): Donor hub with giving tips, community stories, and charitable guidance
- [Crisis Hub](https://www.gofundme.com/c/act): Crisis response guide: fundraiser setup, fund distribution, community safety
